description: Says whether a video will post on each platform (as a Reel, Short or video, and as an Instagram or Facebook Story), from its technical facts: size in bytes, length, width and height, frame rate, video and audio codec, sample rate, container, HDR and whether the index is at the front. Returns a verdict per platform with each check's message.

audioCodec.description: aac, opus, mp3…, or none for a video without sound.

fastStart.description: The index (moov) comes before the media data.

height.description: Display height in pixels, after rotation.

videoCodec.description: h264, hevc, vp9, av1, prores… (ffprobe's codec_name, or avc1/hvc1 and the like).

width.description: Display width in pixels, after rotation.

name: check_video
title: Check a video
